title: Autism-associated substitutions at ASN374 disrupt FORKHEAD box P2-mediated regulation of DNA binding by t-box BRAIN protein 1.
abstract: Biochemical study showing the FOXP2 forkhead domain binds the TBR1 T-box domain, modulated by residue Asn374. Autism-associated N374H and N374Y substitutions weaken TBR1 binding to T-box DNA and impair FOXP2-dependent regulation of TBR1: both variants reduce FOXP2-TBR1 affinity yet paradoxically resist FOXP2-driven dissociation of TBR1 from DNA. MD simulations indicate Asn374 is an allosteric control point coupling TBR1 DNA-binding dynamics to FOXP2 engagement. Methods: fluorescence anisotropy, EMSA, molecular modelling/dynamics.
